title: SF Symbols in SwiftUI
description: Discover how you can incorporate SF Symbols into your SwiftUI app. We’ll explore basic techniques for presenting symbols, customizing their size, and showing different variants. We’ll also take you through the latest updates to symbol colorization and help you pick the right tool for your app’s needs.

codeSnippets.title: Creating Symbols
Accessibility Label
codeSnippets.code:
Image(systemName: "heart")
    .accessibilityLabel("Ace of Hearts")

Image(systemName: "person.circle")
    .accessibilityLabel("Profile")

Image("queen.heart")

// Localizeable.strings
"queen.heart" = "Queen of Hearts";

codeSnippets.title: Customizing Color
codeSnippets.code:
Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")

Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .foregroundStyle(.red)

Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .foregroundStyle(.tint)

Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

codeSnippets.title: Customizing Font
codeSnippets.code:
Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .font(.body)

Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .font(.caption)

Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .font(.system(size: 10))

codeSnippets.title: Customizing Scale
codeSnippets.code:
Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .imageScale(.large)

Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .imageScale(.medium)

Label("Heart", systemImage: "heart")
    .imageScale(.small)

codeSnippets.title: Customizing Variants
Monochrome
codeSnippets.code:
List {
    Label("Ace of Hearts", systemImage: "suit.heart")
    Label("Ace of Spades", systemImage: "suit.spade")
    Label("Ace of Diamonds", systemImage: "suit.diamond")
    Label("Ace of Clubs", systemImage: "suit.club")
    Label("Queen of Hearts", image: "queen.heart")
}
.symbolVariant(.fill)

codeSnippets.title: Multicolor
codeSnippets.code:
List {
    Label("Ace of Hearts", systemImage: "suit.heart")
    Label("Ace of Spades", systemImage: "suit.spade")
    Label("Ace of Diamonds", systemImage: "suit.diamond")
    Label("Ace of Clubs", systemImage: "suit.club")
    Label("Queen of Hearts", image: "queen.heart")
}
.symbolVariant(.fill)
.symbolRenderingMode(.multicolor)
